$comment: Participant TCT claims-sibling convention: each participants[i].tct is a __JWS_TCT__ compact-JWS placeholder with a `tct_claims` sibling in the SAME participant object carrying the decoded claims to mint. The minter resolves each tct, strips every tct_claims companion, then signs the bundle (__VALID_A_SIG__: coordinator kat-keypair-001 over the JCS-canonical bytes of the INNER session_bundle body, excluding the `signature` member and excluding the `{"session_bundle": ...}` transport wrapper (RFC-AITP-0010 §3, RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.1) — the minted TCT strings are covered verbatim). The __VALID_A_SIG__ placeholder sits INSIDE the session_bundle body (last member), not beside the wrapper: the bundle is redistributable and carries its own proof, so a minting tool must resolve the placeholder at its inner location and write the signature back there.
description: Session Trust Bundle happy path (RFC-AITP-0010 §5, aitp/0.3 shape; reuses kat-session-bundle-001 as re-specified for aitp/0.3). Coordinator (kat-keypair-001) has run bilateral Mutual Handshakes with two participants (kat-keypair-002 = B, kat-keypair-003 = C) and minted a peer-issued TCT (compact JWS, typ aitp-tct+jwt) for each. The bundle embeds both TCT strings verbatim and is JCS-signed by the coordinator. The receiving participant (B in this fixture) verifies: bundle version (aitp/0.3), expiry, expiry-window invariant (bundle.expires_at = min of the embedded TCTs' exp claims), participants non-empty, coordinator key resolution from the coordinator's Manifest (`input.coordinator_manifest`, step 5), bundle signature, every embedded TCT (strict JWS parse, typ, AID-pinned alg, signature; iss claim = coordinator, aud claim = participant.aid), and self-membership. All checks pass; B accepts the bundle and the membership it asserts.

expected.rationale: The coordinator's Manifest (`input.coordinator_manifest`) verifies (RFC-AITP-0003 §5) and designates the coordinator's AID; the bundle signature verifies under the key it designates; both embedded TCT compact JWS strings verify under the coordinator's key with iss = coordinator and aud = participant aid; receiver's AID is in participants; expires_at = 1711903600 = min(1711903600, 1711905600).
